description: Geospatial data for landslide susceptibility mapping, Gammo Highlands, Ethiopia is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. The data contains geospatial data, model scripts, and figure generation code used in the study. The full pipeline used two modular Python scripts: lsm pipeline final.py (end-to-end pipeline: Phases 0–6, including CRS verification, feature extraction, ML training, spatial mapping, Jenks classification, and manuscript generation) and generate all manuscript figures final 1.py. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
